tasks.description: Design and create a basic dashboard layout for reports. This will involve setting up the initial UI components and framework for the dashboard. Further details will be added later.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the reports section, then the dashboard is displayed.

tasks.description: Gather and document the specific requirements for the reporting dashboard, including the types of reports to be displayed, user interactions, and any filtering or sorting capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of requirements, when they are documented, then the document is shared with the development team.

tasks.description: Integrate the reports into the dashboard, ensuring that data is correctly fetched and displayed. This task depends on the details defined in the previous task.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report is selected, when the dashboard is loaded, then the report data is correctly displayed.
